name: split-text
title: Split Text
description: A headline or short line that arrives a word, or a letter, at a time the first time it scrolls into view. It gives one line on a page a moment of attention; use it once or twice per page, on text short enough to read while it arrives.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/split-text

Installed to `components/ui/effects/split-text.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/effects/split-text';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/split-text

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
